summary: 7 steps: 0 before the move (0 blocking), 0 to re-create, 1 for the move itself, 4 checks afterwards and 2 to roll back.

phases.title: Before the move: fix the blockers and make the decisions
phases.intro: Everything here is settled while the account is still at its current position. NO-GO steps block the move; REVIEW steps need a decision or a check by hand.

phases.title: Before the move: re-create what does not travel
phases.intro: Shares, delegations, permission sets and stacks that are scoped to the account's current position do not follow it. Prepare the replacements now so nothing is interrupted.

phases.title: The move
phases.intro: One Organizations call, or the Account Factory flow when Control Tower governs the account.

steps.title: Move the account from OU Sandbox (ou-lark-sand) to OU Production (ou-lark-prod)
steps.detail: A single call; the new chain of policies applies immediately. Policies attached directly to the account stay attached.

phases.title: After the move: checks
phases.intro: Confirm what the simulation predicted and finish what could only be done once the account is at its new position.

steps.title: Confirm the account sits under OU Production (ou-lark-prod) and the expected policies reach it
steps.detail: The parent must be ou-lark-prod. The policies listed for the account should match the target chain of the simulation (added: SCP Larkspur-Allowed-Regions, BACKUP Larkspur-Daily-Backups).

steps.title: Share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists becomes available: ec2:PrefixList
steps.detail: Shared by account 111111111112 with OU ou-lark-work.
steps.finding: Share larkspur-workload-prefix-lists becomes available after the move: ec2:PrefixList

steps.title: Confirm StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles deployed its stack instances to the account
steps.detail: Audit and break-glass IAM roles for workload accounts. Stack instances are created automatically when auto-deployment is on.
steps.finding: StackSet larkspur-baseline-roles starts targeting the account

evidence.note: admin 111111111111; targets OUs ou-lark-work accounts ; regions us-east-1; auto-deployment true; retain on removal false

steps.title: Collect a fresh snapshot and simulate the account at its new position
steps.detail: With the account inside the target organization, a simulation of the account against its own parent compares it with itself and should come back GO, which closes the runbook.

phases.title: Rollback
phases.intro: If something breaks, this puts the account back where it was. Built from the source policy chain of the simulation.

steps.title: Move the account back to OU Sandbox (ou-lark-sand)
steps.detail: The reverse of the move; the original chain applies again immediately.

steps.title: Verify the original policy chain reaches the account again
steps.detail: Compare with the source chain recorded by the simulation, root to account.
